line-1.text: Hi Emma! What book are you reading on your tablet right now?

line-2.text: I am reading a science fiction story about space travel. What book genre do you like most, Alex?

line-3.text: I really love mystery novels. I like trying to solve the case before the ending!

line-4.text: Is the one you are reading a best-seller? I heard mysteries can be real page-turners.

line-5.text: Yes! It is so good that I cannot put it down. But I notice you mostly read on a screen.

line-6.text: Right. A digital e-reader is very light. I can carry fifty books on the train every morning.

line-7.text: That is true. I still prefer physical paperbacks, though. I love the smell of paper, and I can rest my eyes.

line-8.text: I get that. But I also listen to audiobooks when my eyes are tired. Have you ever tried those?

line-9.text: Not really. I like my old habits. I read print books to slow down and unplug from technology.

line-10.text: That makes sense! Whether it is in print or digital format, a good story is always amazing.
